scope: Preregistered paired CPU v2 queue study after exploratory pilot; no policy tuning during main evaluation

analysis.change_detection: first 3 consecutive pre-action expected-service forecasts within .5 of post-shift generative mean; null=censored or inapplicable, never oracle input
analysis.prediction_error: MAE against executed-tick capacity, read only by evaluator after episode
analysis.decision_change: normal-choice difference at next public State with vs without the last probe Experience; includes that Experience ordinary processing information, not a causal marginal measurement estimate
analysis.repeat: full normalized semantic trace equality, original Gate digest and completed receipt checked before normalization
analysis.pilot: holding costs .25/1/2/4 explored analytically; actual pilot .25 and1, seed909, ticks8; main contains positive and negative cases declared before main run
analysis.statistics: all paired seeds published; n=3 is small, no general superiority or significance claim; CPU/wall single host and order effects
analysis.budget: all strategies width4/nodes4/calls32; No Probe offers3, sensors4. Extra No Probe width3/nodes3/calls24 control for every seed/case. No Probe is the new common Bayesian controller, not frozen v1 EMA results
